# cmm.dev

> Chris McConnell's personal portfolio site. Chris is a practitioner in GRC
> and cybersecurity who builds the AI systems he uses: compliance engines for
> clients, and revenue and GTM systems for his own pipeline, then open-sources
> the methodology. The site lists his projects, background, and links.

## Pages

- Home (/#home): tagline "Practitioner Who Builds" and a short intro to
  Chris's GRC and cybersecurity work, plus AI agent and GTM engineering.
- Projects (/#projects): a table of 8 open-source projects with language and
  star counts.
- About (/#about): Chris's bio, career history, education, location, focus
  areas, and links.
- Viz (/viz/): a small gallery of one-off data visualizations, in its own
  editorial style. First chart: "Messi From The Spot", every career penalty
  plotted by where it crossed the goal.

## Projects

- [gilfoyle](https://github.com/miqcie/gilfoyle): Technical review agent with Gilfoyle-style precision (JavaScript, 21 stars)
- [cal-attio-sync](https://github.com/miqcie/cal-attio-sync): Free Cal.com → Attio booking sync, live in production (TypeScript, 0 stars)
- [grepai-beads-helpers](https://github.com/miqcie/grepai-beads-helpers): Automation scripts for semantic code search & AI memory (Shell, 7 stars)
- [nightscout-clock](https://github.com/miqcie/nightscout-clock): CGM desk-clock firmware for my daughter's T1D (C++, 0 stars)
- [mondrian](https://github.com/miqcie/mondrian): Evidence-first Zero Trust runtime for startups (Go, 0 stars)
- [T1DCalculator](https://github.com/miqcie/T1DCalculator): iOS insulin dose calculator using medical formulas (Swift, 0 stars)
- [voice-pipeline](https://github.com/miqcie/voice-pipeline): Voice capture → transcribe → classify → route (Python, 0 stars)
- [Humaine-studio](https://github.com/miqcie/Humaine-studio): Thought lab on human + AI collaboration (HTML, 1 star)

## About

- Name: Chris McConnell, MBA
- Now: Founder, Eagle Ridge Advisory; Applied AI Strategist, Humaine Studio
- Before: Director, Digital & Business Transformation, Deep Water Point
- Education: NYU Stern MBA, University of Idaho BA
- Location: Richmond, Virginia
- Focus: CMMC, Zero Trust, AI Agents, GTM Engineering
- Led 300+ consultants through Zero Trust for CMMC compliance.
- Built AI workflows that cut 160 hrs/month to 12.
- Now builds the tools and runs the engagements himself.
